title: Straighten
angleHint: Clockwise rotation; negative values rotate counterclockwise. The preview is immediate; the computation runs when you click Apply.
resetHint: Sets the angle back to zero
traceHint: Drag a line on the image along a feature that should be horizontal or vertical: the angle is calculated automatically
northHint: Rotates the image so that celestial north is at the top
northUnavailableHint: Available when the image has an astrometric solution, that is, the exact position of the field in the sky (Objects step, Plate solve)
trimEdgesHint: Sets the crop to the largest rectangle with no uncovered corners. The crop stays editable and no data is removed.
